*Create a new object for the reduced data*

```{r}
herero <- data_full_herero
damara <- data_full_damara
germany <- data_full_germany
us <- data_full_us
```


*Compare the column names across datasets, to prepare for combining into one dataset*

```{r}
#Put columns from all four datasets side by side for comparison

datasets <- list(herero, damara, germany, us)

# Put column names side by side
cols <- list(names(herero), names(damara), names(germany), names(us))

# Pad shorter lists with NA
cols <- lapply(cols, function(x) {
  length(x) <- max(lengths(cols))
  x
})

# Create table of all column names in each dataset to compare 
compare_col_names <- as.data.frame(cols)
names(compare_col_names) <- c("herero", "damara", "germany", "us")

View(compare_col_names)
```

*Combine all four different language datasets by binding together, because my research questions are focused on comparing across all conservancies, and all locations, so I need the dataset to be one large singular file.*
*Bind all columns first*

```{r}

# Combine four datasets, matching columns by name
all_cols <- unique(c(names(herero), names(damara), names(germany), names(us)))

datasets <- lapply(list(herero, damara, germany, us), function(df) {
  df[setdiff(all_cols, names(df))] <- NA
  df[all_cols]
})

all_dfs_combined <- do.call(rbind, datasets)

View(all_dfs_combined)

#Check that bind has been done correctly - number of rows make sense:

sum(sapply(list(herero, damara, germany, us), nrow))
nrow(all_dfs_combined)

#Check combined dataset matches expected result:

originals <- list(herero, damara, germany, us)

# Recreate the combined dataset from the originals
expected <- do.call(rbind, lapply(originals, function(df) {
  df[setdiff(all_cols, names(df))] <- NA
  df[all_cols]
}))

# Compare it with your combined dataset. Returns TRUE = combined dataset matches expected incl number of rows, column names, column order, and values
isTRUE(all.equal(expected, all_dfs_combined))

```

*Remove unnecessary columns and rows from combined dataset*

```{r}

# Display all column names with their numbers:
data.frame(Number = seq_along(all_dfs_combined), Name = names(all_dfs_combined))

# Remove unnecessary columns:
all_dfs_combined <- all_dfs_combined[, !names(all_dfs_combined) %in% c("IPAddress","Progress","Finished","RecipientLastName","RecipientFirstName","RecipientEmail","ExternalReference","opp","tg", "transaction_id","Q_BallotBoxStuffing","Q_RelevantIDDuplicate","Q_RelevantIDFraudScore","Q_RelevantIDDuplicateScore","pureSpectrumSignatureValue", "supplier_id", "Q_CHL", "PS", "gc", "term", "Vendor", "QPMID", "tern")]
ncol(all_dfs_combined)
```
